commitMessage: Code clean up.
dslRule:
<!id: remove.redundant.null.check.in.if>
<!description: Remove redundant null check from an 'if' condition when the variable is guaranteed non-null by static analysis.
This transformation is safe only when static analysis confirms that '$var' is provably non-null in this specific context, making the '$var != null' check superfluous.>
<!severity: HINT>
if ($var != null && $condition) :: isNonNull($var)
=> if ($condition)
;;

commitMessage: Fixed bug 347302: [preferences] NumberFormatException: For input string: "container" when creating new Java project
dslRule:
<!id: org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.preferences.encode_desc_append>
<!description: Encodes a description string by wrapping it in a call to the local static `encode()` method before appending it to a `StringBuffer`.
This ensures the string is properly formatted to prevent `NumberFormatException` during subsequent decoding operations.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$buffer.append($desc); :: instanceof($buffer, "java.lang.StringBuffer")
=>
$buffer.append(encode($desc));
;;
summary: Wrap a `String` argument passed to `StringBuffer.append()` with a call to the local static `encode()` method.

commitMessage: Fixed missing dialog field update call.
dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.internal.dialogfield.refresh.validate>
<!description: After refreshing a DialogField, ensure its validation is triggered.
This rule applies to internal Eclipse UI components (org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField and its subtypes).>
<!severity: HINT>
$x.refresh() :: instanceof($x, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField")
=>
$x.refresh()
$x.dialogFieldChanged()
;;
summary: Adds `dialogFieldChanged()` call after `refresh()` on `DialogField` instances to trigger immediate UI validation. This applies only to types derived from `org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.wizards.dialogfields.DialogField`.

commitMessage: Fixed bug 351349: [type hierarchy] NullPointerException after closing type hierarchy view after a cancel
dslRule:
<!id: array-equals-to-arrays-equals>
<!description: Replaces array.equals(otherArray) with java.util.Arrays.equals(array, otherArray) to correctly compare array contents instead of references, fixing a common subtle bug.>
<!severity: WARNING>
java.lang.Object $array1.equals(java.lang.Object $array2) :: instanceof($array1, "java.lang.Object[]")
=> java.util.Arrays.equals($array1, $array2)
;;
summary: Replace array.equals() with Arrays.equals() for content comparison.
